answer: Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. The design leans on unique-model fingerprint attestation, voided if the audit panel is not diverse, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks. Each submission hangs on the atlas of a task receipt, and the horizon is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. By the dune of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short.
